single_node_qwen_trace.description: Single-node QwenTrace peak effective RPS and latency constraints from Tables 3 and 4.

effective_rps.description: Trace-level goodput: offered request rate multiplied by recomputed per-request SLO success rate.

slo_violation_rate.description: Fraction of requests that violate either the TTFT SLO or the envelope TPOT SLO.

ttft_slo_violation_rate.description: Fraction of requests whose first-token latency exceeds that request's TTFT SLO.

envelope_tpot_slo_violation_rate.description: Fraction of requests whose envelope-line TPOT exceeds that request's TPOT SLO.

ttft_p95_ms.description: P95 first-token latency, included to catch methods that optimize only the extreme tail.

ttft_p99_ms.description: P99 first-token latency, the paper's headline prefill-tail latency constraint.

tpot_p95_ms.description: P95 raw per-output-token latency, tracking token delivery smoothness outside the envelope formulation.

tpot_p99_ms.description: P99 raw per-output-token latency, matching the latency table's token-delivery view.

envelope_tpot_p95_ms.description: P95 envelope-line TPOT latency, probing whether accumulated slack is used without broad TPOT regressions.

envelope_tpot_p99_ms.description: P99 envelope-line TPOT latency, the scheduler's monotonic TPOT SLO formulation.
